menu.alt: The Zacess Games menu in Deep Contrast Dark: fourteen games in two columns with the chosen game described underneath

games.name: Stackline
games.description: Circuit parts fall into two wells. A full row whose parts all carry wire across joins the rails and clears, pushing a feedback row with one break into the other well
games.goal: Keep both wells clear for as long as possible by joining rows of wire from rail to rail.
games.ending: There is no end to win. The game ends when a well overflows at the top.
games.tip: Keep upright parts together in columns you do not need to clear soon.
games.keys: `←` `→` (or `H` `L`) move. `↑` (or `K` or `X`) turns. `↓` (or `J`) moves one row down. `Enter` drops. `Tab` moves the piece to the other well
games.alt: Stackline: circuit parts falling into two wells with the rails marked plus and minus

games.name: Merge Gates
games.description: Push four-bit tiles together through a track of logic gates to make the target output
games.goal: Make a tile equal the target output, as often as you can.
games.ending: Each target allows 10 pushes. Missing one is a fault. The game ends at the third fault.
games.tip: Read the next gates on the track before you push.
games.keys: Arrows (or `H` `J` `K` `L`) move the cursor. `W` `A` `S` `D` push the tile up, left, down or right. `Enter` grabs; then an arrow pushes
games.alt: Merge Gates: four-bit tiles on a board beside a track of logic gates and the target output

games.name: Termle
games.description: A daily electronics or programming term from a category clue and arrow feedback, with a streak for days in a row
games.goal: Guess the day's electronics or programming term in six tries.
games.ending: Solve the term to win. Six tries without it shows the answer and resets the streak.
games.tip: An arrow tells you which way to move a letter, so two guesses can place most of them.
games.keys: Letters type. `Backspace` deletes. `Enter` guesses. `Tab` reveals a letter for one try
games.alt: Termle: guesses of the day's term with letters marked in place, elsewhere or not used

games.name: Signal
games.description: A calm rhythm game: catch notes on three lanes as they reach the line
games.summary: a calm rhythm of soft tones
games.goal: Catch every note of a calm song as it reaches the line.
games.ending: The song ends when every note has passed. There is no way to lose; the end screen shows how many were in time, close and missed.
games.tip: Watch the notes rather than listen; the tones are a garnish and the song plays the same muted.
games.keys: `↑` or `1` plays the high lane. `→` or `2` the middle lane. `↓` or `3` the low lane
games.alt: Signal: notes travelling along three lanes towards the line

games.name: Trace
games.description: Route wire from a source to light every node without crossing, with vias and one-way nodes
games.goal: Light every node on the board by running wire to it from the source (◆).
games.ending: Light every circuit to win. There is no way to lose: undo or restart a level as often as you like.
games.tip: Lay the long straight runs first and branch from the nodes they light.
games.keys: Arrows (or `H` `J` `K` `L`) lay wire. `Tab` or `Enter` moves the pen to the next lit point. `U` or `Backspace` undoes. `R` restarts
games.alt: Trace: wire laid from a source to light nodes on a grid

games.name: Drift
games.description: Steer a lantern over a quiet landscape to gather light. There is no way to lose
games.summary: a lantern in a quiet landscape
games.goal: Float a lantern over a quiet landscape and gather motes of light.
games.ending: There is no way to lose. Enter ends the journey whenever you like and keeps the light gathered.
games.tip: Reduced motion halves the pace if the scrolling is too much.
games.alt: Drift: a lantern over a quiet landscape gathering light

games.name: Rooms
games.description: A short roguelike through a broken server: carry parts to faults to open the doors
games.goal: Fix every fault in the six rooms of a broken server before its uptime runs out.
games.ending: Fix every room to win. The game ends if uptime reaches 0%.
games.tip: Glitches only move when you do, so stop and plan.
games.alt: Rooms: a room of a broken server with parts, faults and doors

games.name: Relay
games.description: Move a packet through gates that keep time with the move count, portals and one-way tiles
games.goal: Steer a packet to collect every data bit (•) and then reach the exit (⇥), in as few moves as you can.
games.ending: Deliver every level to win. There is no way to lose: undo or restart a level as often as you like.
games.tip: Waiting is the only way to change the beat, so count the moves to each gate.
games.keys: Arrows (or `H` `J` `K` `L`) move. `W` or `Enter` waits a move (so does the full stop). `U` or `Backspace` undoes. `R` restarts
games.alt: Relay: a packet on a track of timed gates, portals and the exit

games.name: Through Ball
games.description: Turn-based football about passing lanes and a keeper's reach, over five attacks
games.goal: Score as many goals as you can from five attacks.
games.ending: The match ends after five attacks. An attack ends with a goal, a save, a blocked shot, a tackle or the clock running out.
games.tip: Draw the keeper to one side, then shoot to the far row from inside the box.
games.keys: Arrows (or `H` `J` `K` `L`) run with the ball. `Tab` picks a teammate. `Enter` passes. `1` `2` `3` shoot at the top, middle or low row
games.alt: Through Ball: three attackers, three defenders and a keeper with the open passing lane dotted

games.name: Slipstream
games.description: A calm road race against the fuel gauge, with slipstreams and a pit lane
games.summary: a calm road race against fuel
games.goal: Drive as far as you can on one tank of fuel at a time.
games.ending: There is no finish line. The run ends after three bumps or when an empty tank coasts to a stop.
games.tip: Tuck in behind a car before the fuel runs low, then pit when the road is clear.
games.keys: `←` `→` (or `H` `L`) change lane. `↑` (or `K`) goes faster and `↓` (or `J`) slower
games.alt: Slipstream: a car on a three-lane road behind traffic with the fuel gauge on the dash

games.name: Array Guard
games.description: Clear drifting debris to protect five satellite dishes, with shields, capsules and waves
games.summary: clear debris from a dish array
games.goal: Protect a row of five satellite dishes from drifting debris for as many waves as you can.
games.ending: There is no last wave. The game ends when every dish is lost.
games.tip: Large debris is slow; clear the small pieces first.
games.alt: Array Guard: debris drifting towards five dishes with their shields

games.name: Heatsink
games.description: Type electronics terms and code fragments before they reach a chip and heat it, with a calm mode
games.summary: type terms to cool a chip
games.goal: Keep the chip (U1) cool by typing the words and code fragments that drift towards it.
games.ending: The game ends when the chip reaches 100°C. In calm mode it ends only when you press Enter.
games.tip: Finish the word nearest the chip before starting another.
games.keys: Every character types; letters match in either case. `Backspace` takes back a letter. `Tab` switches calm mode. `Enter` ends a calm round
games.alt: Heatsink: terms falling towards a chip with its heat gauge

games.name: Touch Typing
games.description: A trainer from the home row to timed tests, with an on-screen keyboard showing the finger for every key. It follows the keyboard in use (UK Mac, UK PC or US), read from the system
games.goal: Learn to type without looking, one group of keys at a time, from the home row to timed tests.
games.ending: There is no losing. Finish a lesson with 95% accuracy or better to unlock the next one. Below that, Enter tries it again with new text.
games.tip: Keep your fingers resting on A S D F and J K L ; and feel for the bumps on F and J.
games.keys: Every character types exactly. `Backspace` takes back a key. `←` `→` choose an unlocked lesson. `Enter` moves on when a lesson is done. `F2` switches the keyboard layout
games.alt: Touch Typing: a lesson line with a marked slip above the keyboard and the finger for the next key

games.name: Learn to Code
games.description: Fifteen tracks from first steps to job-ready: Python, Java, C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, Bash and Linux, Git, Rust, Go, C#, Kotlin, Data Structures and Algorithms and AI in Python. Fill in small programs with hints, teaching messages and saved progress
games.summary: code in Python, Java and C
games.goal: Learn to program from first steps to job-ready, one idea at a time. There are tracks for Python, Java, C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, Bash and Linux, Git, Rust, Go, C# and Kotlin, a shared Data Structures and Algorithms track and an AI track in Python.
games.ending: There is no losing. A track is complete when its last level is solved. The language list shows how many levels each language has done.
games.tip: Read the expected output under the code first; it tells you what each blank must do.
games.keys: Every character types into the marked blank. `Backspace` deletes. `Tab` or `↓` goes to the next blank and `↑` the one before. `Enter` checks, then moves on. `F2` shows a hint. `F3` shows the answer after three tries. `F4` chooses a language
games.alt: Learn to Code: a Python lesson with a blank in the code and a message that teaches
